$schema_note: Hand-curated record of the list the game's own Angelic roll (DropItemAngelicChance) picks its unique from, and the stand-in entries ForgePact #74 adds to it for the length of one roll while Headhunter's or Tyrant's Crown's panel switch is on. The mechanism, in words, is docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md section 13.4 and ForgePact/docs/angelic-roll-hook-research.md sections 'Session 3: list injection (issue #74)' and 'Session 4: the list layout (issue #74)'. No model or generator reads this file: tests/test_sdk_all.py checks only that curated/ is tracked, and the #74 workorder's acceptance criteria read controller_object, list_variable, list_layout, reach, typing, game_build and measurements. A status is one of: pass, fail, not-observed (the check ran and saw nothing to judge), 'not-run (instrument-blind: <why>)' (the instrument could not see what the check asks about) or 'not-run (<why>)' (the check's precondition did not hold, so it was not attempted); 'not established' means no session has asked yet, and 'static reading' marks a claim read locally from the game, never measured. list_layout is the static reading of replan 2 with the outer length Live 1 measured; list_variable stays null until a session's reach check passes on a named list (#74's Live 2, which also fills reach and game_build and adds its own measurements, source forgepact-74-angelic-list-injection-live-2.md). measurements holds one entry per check of each live session, in the style of relic_pick_measurements.json: id is the check's name, kind is validity (the instrument works), acceptance (what a player gets) or research (a question about the game), source the capture file. Static readings below are our own words from a local reading of the game, never its text.
list_entry_shape: array of three numbers [type, sub, b], one per entry of the ds_list the roll draws from (list_layout), resolved by GetUniqueRepoStruct(type, sub, b)

list_layout.entry: array of three numbers [type, sub, b]
list_layout.reading: Controller_obj.lootListUnique is an array of six ds_list ids; the Angelic roll reads its sixth element by the constant index 5, takes ds_list_size of it, draws a random index up to that size, reads the entry with ds_list_find_value and keeps it only when is_array holds, else it draws again; elements 0, 1 and 2 of the entry are the type, sub and b it hands to GetUniqueRepoStruct. The name comes from the runtime's name record beside the roll's variable slot (DerefNear, 2026-10-02) and the three builtin names from the records beside their pointer globals; FindWrites and FindPointers found 0 hits on those three globals. Not established: what the other five elements hold or are keyed by, the sub-list's size, and whether the random index can equal the size (an off-by-one the is_array re-draw would absorb). lootListNormal (outer length 5 on the same instance) is not read by this roll.
list_layout.source: static reading: replan 2 of workorder forgepact-74-angelic-list-injection (local Ghidra project, 2026-10-02); outer length: forgepact-74-angelic-list-injection-live-1.md, step 4

repository.bounds: GameMaker's own array bounds checks: an out-of-range triple raises the runtime's array error rather than missing quietly, so only triples ForgePact's validated pool accepted are ever added

Tyrant's Crown.chosen_by: default until the owner names one: the validated type 0 entry of ForgePact's kAngelicBases with the lowest droprate.base, picked when the pool is built and named in the switch-on log line (Mask of the Celestial in Live 1's research build, 2026-10-02)

static_reading.source: local Ghidra project (bare script names), planning sessions of workorder forgepact-74-angelic-list-injection (replan 1 and replan 2); nothing decompiled is kept in this repository
claims: The roll reads its unique list as a variable of an object-scoped reference whose constant encodes object index 984, Controller_obj: the variable of the first active Controller_obj instance.

The earlier negatives (no lootListUnique global, no lootListUnique instance variable on Loot_Manager_obj) were measured on other scopes than Controller_obj; each shows only that the name is absent from the scope asked, and neither is a measurement of the list. Live 1 measured both again, with the same answer, beside a lootListUnique on Controller_obj.

The variable's name is lootListUnique, established through the name record the runtime keeps beside the roll's variable slot (DerefNear, replan 2) and confirmed by Live 1, which found a variable of exactly that name on Controller_obj. Replan 1's FindSlotNames, SlotRefs, FindPointers and FindRvaTable found 0 hits because they searched for stores and tables, not for that record.
The roll reads element 5 of lootListUnique (the sixth), a ds_list, through ds_list_size, ds_list_find_value and is_array, never the outer array as a list (replan 2; see list_layout).

The same list slot is also read by DropUniqueItems, DropItemHeroic, DropItemDebug, DropItem, the traveling merchant and black market grids, ReturnRandomSatanic, CreateShrineEffect, DoCraftResult and several unnamed object events; who builds it, and whether per zone or per load, is not established.

GetUniqueRepoStruct(type, sub, b) indexes a global three-level array repo[type][sub][b] with bounds checks; sub is 0 for the unique repository and b the unique's own index (Liquor Holster {8, 0, 51}).
The picker re-picks while the definition's base-info flag 40 is set or its rarity field 27 is neither 7 nor 10, then hits when a uniform integer up to the definition's rate is below the chance.

On a hit CreateDefaultParams(sub, b, 1.0) builds the parameter struct from its three arguments and one zero-argument builtin; it, LootGroundCreate, CreateLootInFreePos and LootGroundInit read no repository.
CreateItemNew is missing from the import, so whether it looks the unique up by (c, b) is not established.

The built item carries the parameters as itemDefinitionStruct {w, j, b, a, c}; the Custom Forge hook recognises Headhunter and Tyrant's Crown by the selector {t, a, b, c, j} = {8, 777002, 2, 0, 0} and {0, 777001, 7, 0, 0}.

attribution: Design, ForgePact #74 (2026-10-02, replan 1), as the plugin implements it: a hit is typed from the latest GetUniqueRepoStruct(type, sub, b) read inside the roll, accepted only when its sub and b equal CreateDefaultParams' own first two arguments; a hit with no such read is untyped, stays the game's own and is counted in untyped=. A typed hit is a stand-in candidate only when its whole triple [type, sub, b] is the stand-in's, and is the mod item's with probability 1 / (n + 1), n being how often the vanilla sub-list holds that same whole triple (m*k / (n + m*k) with the research build's copies lever). Since replan 2 the push (ds_list_add), the held read-back and the cut (ds_list_delete from the tail) act on the ds_list at lootListUnique[5], never on the outer array.

reach.what: Whether the roll's picker draws the entries the plugin pushes onto the sub-list: the reach check compares standinPicks= (hits whose CreateDefaultParams pair is a stand-in's) per hit with the switch off and with angelicprobe inject copies 200, in the same session. The held read-back shows only that the list holds the push, not that the roll reads it. In Live 1 the baseline half ran (standinPicks=1 over 57 hits, p0 = 1/57), but the shape check refused the real list (lootListUnique, array_length 6: entry 0 is not three numbers), so nothing was pushed and the switch-on half could not run. #74's Live 2 asks again with the layout taught.

typing.what: The latest GetUniqueRepoStruct read inside the roll before CreateDefaultParams is the picked entry's: over 57 vanilla hits (chance raised to 1e9 by the research lever, both switches off) untyped=0, typeAgree=57 and typeDisagree=0, every hit line carrying a builtType number and lootDelta=1; the counts held at 85 and then 87 hits later in the session (typeAgree=85, then 87, typeDisagree=0). Measured with nothing pushed, so it covers the game's own entries; a hit on a pushed entry is Live 2's.

game_build.what: Whether the game builds exactly one item dressed as Headhunter or Tyrant's Crown for each hit attributed to it, from the rewritten CreateDefaultParams struct, in place of the stand-in: the inject-build check reads ourHits= against built= / crown= / belt= and the ground. Not run in Live 1, because no list was accepted and nothing was pushed; #74's Live 2 asks it once reach has passed.

measurements.what: The installed DLL is the research build under test: lease dll_sha256 f7560e804472fee6b9c7b61457e1c3b1713ba09a2bd5ec15226ffa5874d5be71 (hashed), equal to the workorder's research dll; slot 14, plugin v2.1.0 ready.
